no_durable_note: no durable family at sportsbook prices
method_note: Sportsbook-priced picks only (price class A/B); PrizePicks (MLB-PP, unverified) and class-C rows graded at the model's own odds are excluded. Every surviving (non-cut) family with n >= 40 graded picks, ranked by the LOWER bound of a 1000-resample bootstrap 95% CI on ROI. DURABLE = CI floor above zero AND positive in both chronological halves AND n >= 100. A big headline ROI with a CI spanning zero or a losing second half is FRAGILE, not edge.
caveats: Bootstrap CIs treat picks as independent; correlated slates (same game/day) understate variance.
Split-half stability is a coarse regime check, not a forecast.
Families below n=40 are unscored -- absence here is not endorsement.
All numbers are 1u-flat on the ledger's recorded payouts at the sportsbook price (class A/B).
Working ledger only (the archive is not re-tiered); families are pooled across sports.
